reason: I already run most of my marketing and follow-up automations through Make and HubSpot, so I'd sign up for the free plan to poke at it, but I wouldn't pay 99 € a month in the first month for something that might just sit on top of what I already have.
objection: 'CRM, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...' isn't an integration list. I need to see whether it actually reads and writes to HubSpot and plays with Make, and I have no idea what one 'credit' buys me or how fast 100 a month runs out.
would_change_my_mind: A public integrations page showing a native two-way HubSpot connector plus a Make/Zapier app, and a plain explanation of what a credit equals, so the free trial can prove it saves me real hours.
